items.summary: A host of newcomers are pushing into the high-end water space, which has long been occupied by brands like Fiji, Evian and Voss.

items.title: With Jensen Huang’s Return as C.E.O., Trump Effectively Overrode Nvidia’s Board
items.summary: Nvidia’s board said Mr. Huang would not be back. But President Trump, who pushed for Mr. Huang’s reinstatement, effectively overrode the board, governance experts said.

items.title: 6 Craft Retreats Offer Knitting, Pottery and More for All Skill Levels
items.summary: Interest in crafting hobbies, like knitting or pottery, isn’t new, but several factors in the wake of the pandemic have also made them appealing. Here are some suggestions for hands-on retreats.

items.title: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
items.summary: Naeem Abu Nahel, who had been in the post for two months, is among seven Palestinians reportedly killed in Israeli strikes on Tuesday.

items.title: Land mine casualties soar in Syria, two years after war
items.summary: Nearly 1,000 children are among those killed or injured by explosives left over from the conflict, figures show.
